description: Ultralytics-compatible object detection. The expected endpoints are POST /predict and GET /health; suppliers MAY expose more of the Ultralytics surface but consumers MUST NOT depend on it. This service is model-agnostic: suppliers choose their own detection model and weights, so response quality, class sets, and box coordinates vary and are not guaranteed by the protocol. Every response, including errors, is a single JSON object.

rpc_types.notes: Only POST /predict and GET /health are expected. Request body is multipart/form-data or application/x-www-form-urlencoded with file/source, conf, iou, imgsz, normalize, decimals. Only object detection is served.

specs.notes: Vendor document for the whole Ultralytics Platform, living (no sha256). Request and response shapes of /api/models/{owner}/{project}/{model}/predict apply; this service serves them at POST /predict. specs[0] is the contract.

serving.backend: Any Ultralytics-compatible server exposing POST /predict and GET /health. Recommended: image-inference-server (Rust gateway + NVIDIA Triton Inference Server). Suppliers choose their own detection model; no specific weights are mandated. The operator is responsible for the license of the model they serve.

healthcheck.notes: Pins the detect endpoint: /health reports only enabled endpoints, so an ocr-only deployment fails it.

serving.notes: Use a server with dynamic batching so one backend serves many concurrent requests. Suppliers are responsible for model licensing (e.g. Ultralytics YOLO is AGPL-3.0). It is recommended to isolate the model behind pokt-ml-sidecar and to front it with the HA RelayMiner. See the docs in specs[0] for the full runbook.
